title: zapoteca formosa subsp. mollicula
intro: Zapoteca formosa subsp. mollicula, commonly known as Mexican Buckthorn, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. This plant is rich in bioactive compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The Mexican Buckthorn has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and pain, due to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents of Zapoteca formosa subsp. mollicula include alkaloids and flavonoids, which may contribute to its health benefits, including antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
